info.name: Oracle GoldenGate Data Streams REST API

description.content:
REST API for managing Oracle GoldenGate Data Streams, enabling real-time data distribution to downstream consumers via the Distribution Server. Provides operations for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting data stream configurations, as well as managing AsyncAPI specifications for stream metadata. Based on Oracle GoldenGate 26ai Data Streams REST API documentation.
